description: A single bay at the end of the aisle given over to the things you cook IN rather than the things you cook. Pans hang off a length of reinforcing bar, pots nest on the bottom shelf, and the spoons and tongs bristle out of a catering tin nobody has ever emptied. Everything's priced to outlive you.
